run_view_camera_log: run the script to view rendered and real camera images side by side from log files
create_trifinger_simulation: create a SimFinger simulation with trifingerpro type and visualization enabled
load_platform_log: load robot and camera data log files using TriFingerPlatformLog
configure_pybullet_visualizer: configure the pybullet debug visualizer for shadows and light position
reset_cube_pose: reset the cube base position and orientation from filtered object pose data
